subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers continue with this PR as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback candidate after repair, or route the work to another refreshed candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906?
rationale: The same bug has overlapping open candidate PRs, this branch is dirty, and the remaining proof gap cannot be supplied by ClawSweeper automation.

options.title: Repair This PR Before Merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the narrower predicate, metadata preservation, conflict refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

options.title: Use The Member Candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 becomes mergeable, proof-accepted, and covers the same three delivery paths.

options.title: Waive Live Proof Explicitly
options.body: A maintainer can accept source/API proof, but the predicate, metadata, and dirty-branch blockers still need repair.

recommendation.title: Repair This PR Before Merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the narrower predicate, metadata preservation, conflict refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent Google Chat API/media history and is the best available owner for the canonical-PR choice.
